widgets_values: Kromoss Turbo text to image: 1024x1024, 8 steps, CFG 1, Euler and the simple scheduler with kromoss_8-steps-dmd2-lora.safetensors at strength 1.0, the Kromoss card's ComfyUI recipe; 4 steps also works. The card ships the file as 8-steps-dmd2-lora.safetensors; save it under the name above. kromoss_8-steps-dmd-lora.safetensors, the plain DMD LoRA, is the other choice; use one LoRA at a time. Both were distilled from MOSS-Image Base and also run on it. CFG 1 never evaluates the negative, so Conditioning Zero Out stands in for it and the graph carries no skip layer node. The card warns against merging the LoRA into BF16 weights, because its delta sits close to the BF16 rounding step; Load LoRA (DGX Monarch) bakes it into the weights with ComfyUI's own math, so a render can differ from the card's unmerged diffusers run. It also differs from stock ComfyUI's default loader, which applies the LoRA as each weight is cast: in the 2026-10-21 tests the bake matched stock's merge on every patched weight, and at strength 1.0 the render landed 0.0489 to 0.0635 one-step NRMS from stock's default render. ComfyUI's native shift of 5 is the vendor's; add no shift node. Model Sampling SD3 (DGX Monarch) samples at multiplier 1000, which would render noise on this model, so it refuses here. The vendor recommends 1, 1.5 or 2 MP and reports 0.25 to 4 MP working, with sides in multiples of 16; the model trained at up to about 1 MP. English works best and Chinese is supported. The vendor's pipeline reads up to 4096 tokens after its chat template; ComfyUI sets no such cap. Describe the finished image, put any text to render in double quotes, and use real line breaks where its lines should break. For tag prompts the guide's order is quality, score, meta, year, character, series, artist, then general tags, with @ before an artist name. Kromoss is the lodestones' full fine-tune of MOSS-Image Base at 1024 px. It shares the file layout, encoder and decoder of the Comfy-Org MOSS-Image files, so it drops in wherever they run. Its weights have changed under the same file names; example_workflows/artifacts.toml pins the sha256 this graph names, and the pinned model card is https://huggingface.co/lodestones/Kromoss/blob/7f9bb7b06d7b6c27d294b0bab5a2b3056c379279/README.md . Comfy-Org's own MOSS-Image graphs can rewrite a short request into a full caption with Text Generate on this same encoder; that step runs on the driver, and its memory is outside dgx-monarch's driver estimate. The INT8 ConvRot DiT files cannot be used on this graph, which always carries a LoRA: with any LoRA they refuse on every topology (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md #129). This graph uses the BF16 file, which asks nothing. Auto picks Ulysses on a configured pair. In the 2026-10-21 hardware tests, uly2 with either LoRA matched dgx-monarch's own one-GPU render exactly at one step and ran about 1.5 times as fast as one GPU with the first Spark capped at 2100 MHz; see docs/BENCHMARKS.md for the walls and docs/VALIDATION.md#evidence-kromoss for the scope. ring2 is not supported on this graph: in the 2026-10-21 tests ring2 with a LoRA failed its first-use gate, so use uly2. Expects kromoss_bf16.safetensors in models/diffusion_models, kromoss_8-steps-dmd2-lora.safetensors in models/loras, qwen3.5_9b_bf16.safetensors in models/text_encoders (CLIP type moss_image) and flux2-vae_small.safetensors in models/vae, the FLUX.2 small decoder; the larger flux2-vae.safetensors other FLUX graphs use is a different decoder, and the file of that name in Comfy-Org's MOSS-Image repository holds other bytes again, so never copy it over yours. qwen3.5_9b_int8_convrot.safetensors is a smaller drop-in encoder. Needs ComfyUI 0.42.0 or newer on the driver and every Worker. MOSS-Image Base and SFT, Kromoss and its two LoRAs, the Qwen3.5-9B text encoder and the FLUX.2 small decoder are all released under Apache-2.0. The first render of a new model runs the identity gate, comparing the mesh with a stock single-GPU load before producing pixels. Allow a few minutes for proof renders. Later renders of the same combination skip the gate. This graph is derived from the family adapter and stock node definitions, without a committed reference render. Check filenames and shapes against your artifacts before running it.
